questions.question: The problem and solution reproduce Hugo Steinhaus’s problem no. 49, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the original authorship from Mansur’s adaptation, translation, and illustration work.

localizations.source: The problem and solution reproduce Hugo Steinhaus’s problem no. 49, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the original authorship from Mansur’s adaptation, translation, and illustration work.
